entity.name: EnovaMaker
entity.description: Declarative NixOS modules for self-hosting, Tor circumvention infrastructure and supply-chain verification.

projects.name: nixos-webtunnel-bridge
projects.description: Deploy a Tor WebTunnel bridge relay on NixOS from a single declaration: Tor, the webtunnel transport, nginx with TLS, and a cover site. Working module with a NixOS VM test, CI green.

projects.name: nixos-tor-anti-dos
projects.description: Per-source rate limiting for a Tor relay's ORPort, declared once on NixOS: nftables with a dynamic set per address family. Working module, two-node VM test, CI.

projects.name: nixos-provenance-guard
projects.description: Update-time provenance verification and supply-chain risk scoring for Nix flakes: checks that a new flake-input revision is a legitimate history continuation, and scores each input's health. Design preview.

projects.name: nixos-sovereign-host
projects.description: Declarative self-sovereign hosting for communities: Matrix with bridges, Syncthing, monitoring, backup and SSO composed from a single NixOS flake. Design preview.

projects.name: nixos-sovereign-host-censorship
projects.description: Censorship-resilience layer for nixos-sovereign-host: declarative Tor onion services, an obfs4 bridge relay, metadata hardening and a one-flag lockdown mode. Design preview.

projects.name: nixos-taler
projects.description: Production-operations layer for GNU Taler on NixOS: adds an auditor role, typed AML/KYC options, TLS/ACME, encrypted backups, secrets management and systemd sandboxing on top of the nixpkgs module. Design preview.

projects.name: nixos-local-first
projects.description: Declarative self-hosting for the NextGraph encrypted local-first stack on NixOS: broker packaging, E2EE off-site backup, monitoring and an operator CLI. Design preview.

projects.name: nixos-iot-edge
projects.description: Declarative IoT data ingestion for NixOS: one services.iot-edge block wires up an MQTT broker, a time-series store (SQLite, InfluxDB or TimescaleDB) and a query API. Design preview.
